Cidna features

Everything personal money management needs, in one light and private app.

Start & account

Guest mode

Start with no account or phone number, protected by a passcode or fingerprint. Later move data into a new account or start fresh.

Phone-number account

Sign up with a one-time SMS code, recover your password with a recovery key, and delete softly with a 30-day restore window.

Multi-device

Sync across phones with one account; device list, remote sign-out and new-device alerts.

Record & categorise

Transactions

Record income and expenses, browse history, review pending transactions and use the quick-add shortcut.

Voice entry

Say the transaction title and check it before saving.

Categories

Predefined and custom categories, plus category suggestions.

Bank SMS (direct build)

Bank SMS are detected and offered as pending transactions, processed on the phone only. Direct build only.

Plan

Budgets & limits

A spending limit per category, with progress bars and alerts.

Savings piggy banks

A piggy bank per goal, deposits and withdrawals, and scheduled monthly deposits.

Debts & receivables

Money owed and expected, partial payments, due dates and reminders.

Insight & output

Analytics

Summaries and charts with Jalali or Gregorian dates.

PDF & Excel export

Export your records for any period.

Transaction image cards

Share a transaction as an image that follows the app’s language, direction and currency.

Privacy & security

End-to-end encryption

Financial records are encrypted on the phone with AES-256-GCM before sync; the server stores ciphertext only.

App lock & biometrics

A passcode, optional fingerprint and an encrypted on-device database.

Offline after sign-in

After the first successful sign-in it works with no internet and syncs on the next connection.

Free, no ads

No subscription, in-app purchases, ads or third-party trackers.

Everyday comfort

Persian & English

Both languages in full, with correct right-to-left and left-to-right layout.

Jalali, Gregorian, Toman, Rial

Dates and amounts the way you think of them.

Hide amounts

Hide the home-screen amounts with one tap.

Light & dark theme

Both themes — the same palette you see on this website.

Notifications & reminders

Reminders for debt due dates and goals, plus security alerts.

Balance widget

See your balance on the home screen without opening the app.

Ready to try it?

It’s free and starts even without an account.
